# War Scroll Column 3 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 3 | **Condition:** complete

---

**3:1** And on the great standard which is at the head of all the people they shall write: "People of God," together with the names of Israel and Aaron, and the names of the twelve tribes of Israel

**3:2** according to their order of birth. And on the standard of the heads of the camps of the three tribes they shall write: [...] and the name of the chief of the camp

**3:3** and the names of the chiefs of its thousands, and the names of the chiefs of its hundreds, and on his standard — the standard of the tribe — they shall write: "Standard of God [...]"

**3:4** and the name of the chief of the tribe and the names of the chiefs of its ten-thousands and the names of the chiefs of its thousands.

**3:5** And on the standard of the ten-thousand they shall write: "The wrath of God is kindled against Belial and against all the men of his lot, leaving no remnant,"

**3:6** and the name of the chief of the ten-thousand and the names of the chiefs of its thousands. And on the standard of the thousand they shall write:

**3:7** "The anger of God rages against the Sons of Darkness; he shall not relent until they are annihilated," and the name of the chief of the thousand

**3:8** and the names of the chiefs of its hundreds. And on the standard of the hundred they shall write: "From God comes the hand of war against all

**3:9** wicked flesh," and the name of the chief of the hundred and the names of the chiefs of its tens. And on the standard of the fifty they shall write:

**3:10** "The stand of wickedness has ended by the might of God," and the name of the chief of the fifty and the names of the chiefs of its tens.

**3:11** And on the standard of the ten they shall write: "Songs of joy to God upon the ten-stringed harp," and the name of the chief of the ten and the names

**3:12** of the nine men under his command. And when they go forth to battle they shall write on their standards: "Truth of God," "Righteousness of God,"

**3:13** "Glory of God," "Justice of God," and after these the full order of their names. And when they draw near to battle they shall write on their standards:

**3:14** "Right Hand of God," "Appointed Time of God," "Tumult of God," "Slain of God." And after these the full order of their names.

**3:15** And when they return from battle they shall write on their standards: "Exaltation of God," "Greatness of God," "Praises of God," "Glory of God,"

**3:16** with the full order of their names. The rule of the standards of the congregation: When they go forth to battle they shall write on the first standard:

**3:17** "Congregation of God"; on the second standard: "Camps of God"; on the third: "Tribes of God"; on the fourth: "Clans of God";

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering of 1QM Column 3. LOGOS structure followed throughout as the formal register suits the quasi-liturgical inscription content. PNEUMA's "banner" rejected in favor of LOGOS's "standard" (Hebrew nes/degel). At 3:7, PNEUMA's "relent" adopted over LOGOS's "turn back" for the anger idiom. The three-phase inscription system (marching, combat, return) is preserved exactly. Inscription phrases retain "of God" construct (LOGOS) rather than "God's" possessive (PNEUMA).*
